subject: Chemistry
question: What volume of oxygen gas measured at s.t.p is required to completely burn $50\text{ cm}^3$ of methane ($\text{CH}_4$)?
explanation:
Step 1: Write the balanced chemical equation:
   $\text{CH}_4 + 2\text{O}_2 \rightarrow \text{CO}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$.
Step 2: By Gay-Lussac's law of combining volumes:
   $1\text{ volume of } \text{CH}_4 \text{ requires } 2\text{ volumes of } \text{O}_2$.
Step 3: $50\text{ cm}^3 \times 2 = 100\text{ cm}^3$.
Result: $100\text{ cm}^3$.
